title: The Discourses of Epictetus, with the Encheiridion and Fragments
author: Epictetus
description: George Long’s English edition brings together the Discourses, the Encheiridion and fragments on Stoic judgement, freedom and the conduct of life.
editionNote: [1900] edition. Philadelphia: David McKay. Edition credit: George Long (1800–1879).
rights: Public-domain historical edition. Source credit and notices are retained.
